description: Creates or updates marketplace vendors, matched by ItemId, then by name. Users are named by UserNames and must exist on the site. Payout accounts are never imported.

items.description: A vendor that sells on the marketplace.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

UserNames.description: The names of the users who manage the vendor. Each must exist on the site.

CommissionPercent.description: The commission the store keeps, from 0 to 100 percent, or none for the store's.

Vendors.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
